name: Doro Wat
description: Slow-simmered tender chicken drumsticks and hard-boiled eggs infused with rich berbere spice blend, clarified niter kibbeh butter, and sweet caramelized onions.

name: Shiro Miti
description: Velvety sun-dried spiced chickpea and broad bean stew cooked in a traditional clay pot (mankorina) with garlic, minced shallots, and ginger.

name: Special Kitfo
description: Prime lean beef finely minced and lightly warmed with mitmita chili powder and fragrant niter kibbeh herb butter. Served with fresh ayib cottage cheese and collard gomen.

name: Zilzil Tibs
description: Sautéed strips of tender beef seared over sizzling high heat in a clay shekla pot with fresh rosemary sprigs, sweet red onions, and charred jalapeño peppers.

name: Injera Firfir
description: Hand-torn rolls of 100% pure teff injera gently simmered in savory berbere tomato stew, infused with cardamom, garlic cloves, and spiced herb butter.

name: Royal Beyaynetu
description: A vibrant rainbow feast of fasting stews: Misir Wat, Ater Kik yellow split peas, Collard Gomen, Fosolia spiced green beans, and seasoned beetroot salad atop teff injera.

name: Misir Wat
description: Split red lentils simmered patiently in rich berbere sauce, roasted garlic, and freshly grated ginger root until deeply savory, hearty, and aromatic.

name: Steamed Gomen
description: Tender highland collard greens delicately braised with crushed cloves of garlic, sliced sweet ginger, and cold-pressed Ethiopian sunflower oil.

name: Derek Tibs Crispy
description: Crisp dry-fried prime beef chunks seasoned with cracked black pepper, fresh sprigs of wild rosemary, and accompanied by house awaze dipping mustard.

name: Kinche Porridge
description: Cracked cracked wheat grains cooked until soft and fluffy, seasoned with aromatic niter kibbeh herb butter and a pinch of warming black cardamom.

name: Traditional Buna Ceremony
description: Single-origin Sidamo or Yirgacheffe coffee beans roasted on open coals, freshly ground, and brewed in a traditional black clay jebena pot with incense.

name: Addis Avocado Spris
description: Layers of ripe thick buttery Ethiopian avocado, fresh sweet mango puree, and squeezed lime juice served chilled with a honey straw.
